name: Phu Long clam
summary: Ngao Phù Long is the clam named for Phù Long, on the northwest shore. Plain ngao, ngao vàng, and ngao trắng do not carry that name.
howToEat: Ask for it by its full name, since an unlabeled ngao is a different order.
where: Phù Long, on the northwest shore of the island.
seoTitle: Ngao Phù Long — the Cat Ba clam
seoDescription: Ngao Phù Long is the clam from Phù Long, on the northwest shore of Cát Bà.
